body.statement: The universal constant \(C_0<\infty\) may be chosen so that every \((G_n,Y_n)\in\mathcal M_n(d;B,c)\) satisfies \[L_n\le C_0\lambda_n,\qquad n^2\sigma_n^2\le L_nH_{2,n},\qquad \mathbb E_U\widehat H_{2,n}=H_{2,n},\qquad \operatorname{Var}_U(\widehat H_{2,n})\le2C_0Bn\lambda_n.\]
body.justification: This proposed squared-endpoint reduction would turn the published CGD operator inequality into uniform moment control for the observable scale.
body.gap: Propositions 5.3--5.4 of \cite{KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024CGD} establish additive and ratio consistency for the spectral variance-bound estimator, respectively, but not this fixed-class quantitative package.
body.consumer: The inequalities supply the denominator and numerator controls for uniform ratio consistency.
